objective: Deliver the completed Data Quality Profiler v0.1.0 implementation for ChatGPT review against the approved design and acceptance gates.
summary: Data Quality Profiler v0.1.0 is implemented under products/drafts/data-quality-profiler/ per the canonical design and implementation plan. POST /v1/profile accepts JSON or CSV datasets, enforces hard limits (1 MiB body, 1,000 records, 250 fields, depth 8, 5s timeout), returns the approved envelope (schema_version, request_id, quality_score, score_breakdown, nested dataset with sha256 schema fingerprint, fields, warnings, processing_ms), and uses structured errors with stable HTTP codes (400/413/415/408). Profiling/scoring/fingerprinting are deterministic (20-run determinism test). The x402 v2 payment boundary is testnet-envelope-only on Base Sepolia (eip155:84532), disabled by default; Base mainnet stays fail-closed. Privacy-safe logging records only aggregate metadata, never payloads. Full suite: 44 tests pass; clean npm ci run verified; native Node smoke tests for /health and /v1/profile passed; Docker unavailable in the Termux environment (docker_not_available).
requested_action: Review implementation against the approved design and acceptance gates. Do not authorize mainnet deployment, wallet funding, paid listing submission, or financial transfers as part of this handoff.
limitations: x402 payment boundary is testnet-envelope-only; no real facilitator verification, signature settlement, or payment was performed.
Docker was not available in the native Termux environment; the container build/run check was recorded as docker_not_available. Native Node startup smoke tests are the verified packaging path.
Base mainnet (eip155:8453) remains fail-closed and untested beyond config rejection.
The product remains under products/drafts/ and has not been moved to products/ready/.
No wallet, seed, private key, API key, or other secret is committed; the configured pay-to address in .env.example is an explicit zero-like example.
No HTTP request is ever made to the facilitator or any external URL from dataset processing; path/URL/shell/HTML strings are treated as inert data.
